name: mploychek-workspace
description: MPloyChek - Enterprise Employment Verification & RBAC Portal

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
